title: One Editor Thinks 32-Inch Gravel Is the Future. Another Gives It Five Years.
content:
Logan makes the case for bigger wheels, Mike blames bad geometry, Lisa sees a Big Wheel, and Blue Hat Guy puts a five-year expiration date on the whole standard.

Read the full article at One Editor Thinks 32-Inch Gravel Is the Future. Another Gives It Five Years. on Velo.
